name_reason: Name already follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and reflects both purpose and data type: domain 'graphics' (battle-scene rendering, consistent with sibling globals in rndscene.c such as data_fd2_graphics_char_sprite_paint_jitter_tick_latch and data_fd2_graphics_bg_animation_frame_idx), descriptor 'char_sprite_shake_jitter_bit' (the 1-bit toggle added as a sleep-status shake to the character-sprite blit offset). No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID involved. Verified against disassembly of the sole accessor fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos (XOR byte ptr [0x53A04],1 at 0x12801; ADD ...,[0x53A04] at 0x128EF).
purpose: Single-bit toggle (0/1) that produces the +0/+1 pixel sleep shake-jitter applied to a sleeping character sprite's blit offset during battle-scene compositing.
logic_summary: Read/written only by fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos. Each time the BIOS tick word (@0x46C, sign-extended) differs from the latched value data_fd2_graphics_char_sprite_paint_jitter_tick_latch (@0x53A08), the bit is flipped (XOR 1, site 0x12801) and the new tick latched. When the painted char has status_sleep_flag set, the bit is added to blit_offset (site 0x128EF, gated by the status_sleep_flag test at 0x128EB), yielding a per-tick +0/+1 horizontal pixel jitter. Zero-init at startup (BSS); the only writer is the XOR flip.
element_semantics: Scalar boolean toggle bit: 0 or 1. Added directly to the workspace blit offset, so value 1 shifts the sleeping sprite by one byte = one pixel horizontally.
